model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the relative share of different languages within a dataset. It comprises ten slices, representing English, Spanish, Russian, German, French, Chinese, Thai, Catalan, Portuguese (Brazil), and Catalan (Brazil). The slices are colored in shades of blue and gray. The largest slice, representing English, occupies 42.8% of the pie, followed by Spanish at 31.4%, Russian at 5.7%, German at 3.6%, French at 2.9%, Chinese at 2.5%, Thai at 1.9%, Portuguese (Brazil) at 1.7%, Catalan at 1.6%, and Catalan (Brazil) at 1.5%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered by decreasing size, with English being the most prominent and Catalan (Brazil) the smallest. A legend is not present.
